Indian squash player Anahat Singh exits London Classic

Indian squash player Anahat Singh's run at the London Squash Classic ended in the quarterfinal stage. She was defeated by Sivasangari Subramaniam of Malaysia. Singh had reached the quarterfinal round of the tournament.
